sources.independent_holdout: New 240 normal + 480 no-request itinerary-family holdout not authored/reviewed/frozen; existing A-E are development/regression diagnostics
sources.title: SFT-as-Context Mitigates Forgetting in Supervised Fine-Tuning
sources.problem: Travel SFT improves no-request rejection but loses normal request selection
sources.method: Parent model re-evaluates original input using raw SFT response as context
sources.conditions: Paper 19 parent-SFT pairs, 11 benchmarks; our travel adaptation is a different task, prompt and 16-token budget
sources.official_code: Author implementation link not identified in the inspected paper; not an exhaustive absence claim
sources.cost: Two sequential inference passes in eventual use; current experiment reuses archived first pass. Paper response-token overhead does not measure our end-to-end serving latency
sources.risk: Wrong reference answer anchoring, more false picks, larger context and latency; no ground-truth fields in model input
sources.development: Frozen D3 360, E mixed 2007 + paired controls 2007; cosine/FINCH first seed and parent self-context control
sources.acceptance: Preregistered D3 normal >=95%, no-request FP <=1%; E four gates plus subtype <=3%, no normal regression or FP increase over SFT. Remaining seeds only if promising; independent holdout before adoption
sources.status: Implemented, logic 7/7, D3 three conditions completed, E three conditions running/pending
sources.paper_fallback: Paper omits pathological/too-long reference and falls back to parent-only. Our failure rows remain in denominator and overflow is recorded without truncation; not literal reproduction
sources.resume: Collect sac_* remaining E outputs through existing worker; compare with saved sources and parent_control. Do not retune prompt on these sets

sources.title: Overcoming Prior Barriers: Supervised Fine-Tuning under Long-Tail Distribution
sources.problem: Training effort may over-cover null/easy concepts and under-cover normal/compound requests
sources.method: PASS clusters reference-derived concepts and allocates instruction budget by parent prior barriers, coverage, harm and redundancy
sources.conditions: Mistral-7B/Qwen2.5-7B, instruction selection budgets 5000 and 10000; our existing training set has 2613 short-answer rows
sources.official_code: Author implementation link not identified in inspected paper
sources.cost: Parent representations and wrong-response/reference probes before selection; extra CPU/GPU storage and fitting
sources.risk: Using E/D3 answers as selection references would leak evaluation information; small training pool may not benefit
sources.development: Training-only concept diagnostics with itinerary-family split; existing D3/E for regression after recipe freeze
sources.acceptance: At fixed train budget, seeds, prompt and backbone, normal selection must not regress while false picks decrease; independent holdout pass required
sources.status: Reviewed, implementation and model effect pending
sources.resume: Prepare train-only concept/reference labels and frozen split before parent representation probes; do not rebalance from E answer inspection

sources.independent_holdout: New 240 normal + 480 no-request itinerary-family holdout not authored/reviewed/frozen; existing A-E are development/regression diagnostics
sources.title: H2CE: Modeling Geo-Semantic Interactions for POI Reranking with Heterogeneous Two-Stage Cross-Encoders
sources.problem: Dining/Activity POI ranking must respect distance and actual numeric evidence as well as semantic relevance
sources.method: Numeric MLP + bucketized semantic input, pointwise filtering then top-K pairwise reranking
sources.conditions: Proprietary local-search training, 5743 test queries, K=10; latency 100 measured + 10 warmup on A100-40GB. POISS offered as comparable public data, not identical reproduction
sources.official_code: Architecture/backbone described; dedicated author inference code/weights not identified in inspected paper
sources.cost: N first-stage scores + 90 ordered pairs at K=10 (45 half-matrix); A100 time is not Oracle ARM time
sources.risk: Noisy LLM labels, duplicated POIs, numeric-source freshness and added serving latency
sources.development: Separate POI relevance/constraint dataset; existing itinerary item selection does not establish retrieval gains
sources.acceptance: Pre-frozen retrieval Recall@k/NDCG, numeric constraint violations, evidence/source preservation, ARM latency/memory budgets; no quality gate yet because labels/budget not fixed
sources.status: Reviewed, candidate pending labels and ARM cost probe; no search implementation/adoption today
sources.resume: Prepare independent human-reviewed travel POI ranking labels and numerical feature contract before training

sources.title: MetaEncoder: Exploring the Limit of Bi-Encoders for Multimodal System One Decision Making with Natural Language Interface
sources.problem: Reuse fixed candidate encodings to lower repeated selection computation
sources.method: Instruction-conditioned request/candidate bi-encoder via unidirectional contrastive learning
sources.conditions: Muse-Glimmer 30B, 11 suites/190 tasks; official evaluation expects bf16 copy about 62GB per GPU, intended 8x80GB
sources.cost: 59,553,433,736 weight bytes plus candidate index; beyond current storage and 16GB GPU bf16 capacity
sources.risk: Reasoning-intensive task limits; official video evaluation selected frame count on test data so not a pristine holdout example
sources.development: Same information/choice set required; embedding-score and JSON-generation paths reported separately
sources.acceptance: Original matched benchmark and resource fit before top-three screening; no current eligibility
sources.status: Reviewed; gated access/NOTICE 401 and resource limitations, no model download or permission expansion
sources.resume: Track official smaller release or fit-compatible implementation; do not claim candidate caching eliminates task encoding cost
